buildUps.title: Can the proposed choice remain traceable locally?
buildUps.body: [Observed] the example document asks whether a local manifest can make the reason for a proposed project choice traceable without another model call in the viewer.
buildUps.alternatives: [Observed] the document contrasts a local manifest with repeated model reconstruction when the viewer opens.
buildUps.rationale: [Observed] this question is written under Open question. [Unknown] no outcome answers it yet.

evidence.quote: Can a local manifest make the reason for a proposed project choice traceable without a separate model call in the viewer?

buildUps.nextStep: [Proposed] examine the linked hypothesis and proposal, retaining the question as unresolved.

buildUps.title: Source links and quotations may support traceability
buildUps.body: [Observed] the document proposes that a reader may trace a choice through its source and exact quotation. [Unknown] this has not been measured.
buildUps.alternatives: [Unknown] the document provides no empirical comparison of traceability with and without quotations.
buildUps.rationale: [Inferred] linking a choice to the text behind it may make its documented reason inspectable; this does not prove the choice correct.

evidence.quote: A reader may be able to trace a proposed choice if the manifest links the choice to a source and an exact quotation. This is a hypothesis, not a measured outcome.

buildUps.nextStep: [Proposed] review the hypothesis before authorizing any check of reader traceability.

buildUps.title: Propose a project-local manifest rather than viewer reanalysis
buildUps.body: [Observed] the document proposes keeping a UTF-8 JSON manifest inside the project for local validation and display. This is a proposed choice, not an accepted decision.
buildUps.alternatives: [Observed] ask a model to reconstruct project reasoning every time the viewer opens instead of maintaining a local manifest.
buildUps.rationale: [Observed] the document proposes retaining inspectable evidence and avoiding repeated semantic analysis. [Unknown] user adoption is not recorded.

evidence.quote: The proposal is to keep a UTF-8 JSON manifest inside the project and let the viewer validate and display it locally.
The proposed rationale is to retain inspectable evidence and avoid repeated semantic analysis in the viewer. No user has accepted this proposal in this example.

buildUps.nextStep: [Proposed] review the proposed choice and evidence before deciding whether to adopt it.
